description: Follow stored trial-start cohorts to their first positive payment at 14, 30 and 60 days. Default campaign/ad-set membership is the last pre-trial touch carrying a campaign/ad-set id in the frozen trial journey. Uses integer mature samples and Wilson intervals. Stored data only; no provider calls or writes.

from.description: Inclusive trial-start cohort beginning; defaults to 90 days before to.

model.description: One integer assignment. Default campaign/ad-set membership is the last pre-trial touch carrying a campaign/ad-set id, not the literal last site touch. First selects the first qualifying touch; ad level requires an ad id.

to.description: Inclusive trial-start cohort end; defaults to now. Payments are followed through now.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_trial_proof
title: Get trial-to-paid proof
